summary: The corrections trail (journal_entry_corrections, mig 503) accepts kind 'void', so an owner void of a posted journal entry is recorded with the original entry, its reversal, actor, time and reason. Adds journal_entry_void_audit_ready() so the void route confirms the trail can take the record before it posts anything. Repairs nothing; no row changes.

preflight.name: the readiness function does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'journal_entry_void_audit_ready'

preflight.name: every existing correction uses one of the three AP kinds
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM journal_entry_corrections WHERE kind NOT IN ('ap_recode', 'ap_line_recode', 'ap_hold_prior_periods')

expected_changes: journal_entry_corrections_kind_check now allows 'ap_recode', 'ap_line_recode', 'ap_hold_prior_periods' and 'void' (was the first three).
New function journal_entry_void_audit_ready() returning true; EXECUTE granted to service_role.
No row changes. Append-only trigger on journal_entry_corrections unchanged.

verify.name: the readiness function answers true
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM (SELECT journal_entry_void_audit_ready() AS ok) x WHERE ok

verify.name: the kind check allows void
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'journal_entry_corrections_kind_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%''void''%'
